data.title: Nature & Outdoors — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: nature
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Walking on the shore, feeling free)

[Hook]
Sunshine… El sol
Waves in line… Olas en fila
Chill vibes… Buenas vibras
Under the sky… Bajo el cielo
Come take a walk with me.

[Verse]
The cactus… El cactus
Stands so tall by the sea.
The hill… La colina
Calls us to climb and see.
Footprints in the sand,
Nature's art so grand.
The swamp… El pantano
Where creatures roam.
The campfire… La fogata
Glows, we're never alone.

[Hook]
Sunshine… El sol
Waves in line… Olas en fila
Chill vibes… Buenas vibras
Under the sky… Bajo el cielo
Come take a walk with me.

[Verse]
The spider web… La telaraña
Catches the morning dew.
The fox… El zorro
Darts by, a flash of brown hue.
By the pond… El estanque
We watch the fish play.
The sunset… La puesta de sol
Paints the world in a golden array.

[Bridge]
La luna rises high,
Stars in the sky… Las estrellas brillan así.
Nature's lullaby,
Guiding our way tonight.

[Hook]
Sunshine… El sol
Waves in line… Olas en fila
Chill vibes… Buenas vibras
